note.text: Single referral-tracking Task (one Coordination Task per Request, per base COW guidance — no second Task). Unlike UC01/UC02 there is no IHE 360X bridge here: the referral is routed through Connie (Connecticut's statewide HIE) to BeneCare (the CTDHP ASO). businessStatus is 'referral-sent' at creation. Task.owner is intentionally NOT set yet — it should be populated with the accepting dental provider (PractitionerRole/role-watson or Organization/org-cornell-scott) once the practice accepts/confirms the appointment (an acceptance step not separately modeled in this I1/I2 build). Later status transitions (in-progress at the dental visit, completed when the encounter summary returns) are Interaction 3/4 work, not built here.
